\[
f - (f \circ B)
\]

The formula shows the default parameter values.

where

- \(f\): The image
- \(B\): The structuring element

The opening keeps everything the element fits into, so the difference keeps only the bright details that are smaller than the element. Erosion takes the smallest value of f(p + z) for z in B. Dilation takes the largest value of f(p - z), which uses the element turned by 180 degrees. Both match the grayscale erosion and dilation of SciPy. On an image of 0 and 255 they are binary erosion and dilation.
